template_question: What are the detailed site details for [site_url]?
llm_output_expectation: These properties represent different scopes of website data tracking: exact URL prefix properties like https://example.com/ or https://www.example.com/ track search performance and indexing for that specific path, while the domain property (sc-domain:example.com) aggregates search data across all subdomains and protocols for the entire domain.
